landing.heroDescription: Simplify your orders, control your inventory, and increase your sales with our complete management platform.

kitchen.title: Kitchen management
kitchen.description: Send orders directly to the kitchen without errors or delays. Optimize your team's workflow and make sure every order is prepared perfectly and on time.

bar.title: Bar management
bar.description: Manage drinks and cocktails precisely and avoid waste. Keep full control of your bar inventory and increase your profitability.

menu.title: Digital menu
menu.description: Update your menu in real time and make it easier for customers to choose. Add photos and detailed descriptions, and change prices instantly.

orders.title: Connected orders
orders.description: Orders recorded by servers appear instantly in the system and in the kitchen. Enjoy faster service and seamless communication throughout your restaurant.

dashboard.title: Intuitive dashboards

history.title: Complete history

legal.privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy explains how TozzoBurger collects, uses, and protects personal data processed through this platform, in accordance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD).
legal.privacyControllerBody: The establishment that operates on the TozzoBurger platform acts as the data controller for the personal data of its own customers and staff. TozzoBurger provides the software used to process that data.
legal.privacyDataCollectedBody: Name, email address, phone number (when provided), login credentials, and order/sale history associated with an establishment.
legal.privacyPurposeBody: Operating the point-of-sale system, keeping a sales history, authenticating users, and sending transactional communications related to the account.
legal.privacySharingBody: Payment processing is handled by Stripe. Infrastructure and content delivery are provided by Cloudflare. We do not sell personal data to third parties.
legal.privacyRightsBody: Under LGPD, you may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization or deletion, data portability, and revocation of consent for your personal data. Contact us at suporte@tozzo.uk to exercise these rights.
legal.privacyRetentionBody: Data is kept while the account or establishment remains active. Deleted records are retained as soft-deleted (marked as removed, not immediately erased) for operational and legal purposes.
legal.termsIntro: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of the TozzoBurger platform.
legal.termsAccountBody: By registering, you confirm that the information provided is accurate and that you are authorized to create an account on behalf of the establishment.
legal.termsUseBody: The platform must be used only for legitimate point-of-sale and business management purposes related to the registered establishment.
legal.termsLiabilityBody: The platform is provided on an as-is basis. TozzoBurger is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of the service.
legal.termsChangesBody: These terms may be updated over time. Continued use of the platform after an update constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
